decisive_spans.text: a large right retroperitoneal predominantly fatty mass in the location of the right adrenal gland

response.rationale: D4 is supported by multiple imaging findings describing a large, well-defined, encapsulated retroperitoneal lesion with mostly fat density and internal soft-tissue density, specifically located in the right adrenal gland area. D1 is a specific type of myelolipoma, but D4 is a more general term that encompasses the findings without being overly specific at this stage. The other candidates are less supported or contradicted.
